messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the PRD + RFC for the Optimize toolkit (batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization recommendation flows). Need a short prioritization matrix and clear launch criteria before Friday.
raj: +1. We should fold in the two enterprise asks: Acme wants deterministic p95 latency guarantees; BankSys is asking for quantized models with verifiable quality thresholds.
tess: Agree. Propose we score features by user impact, implementation effort, and risk (regressions). Simple matrix will help sales/solutions close.
kevin: For effort: batching infra + autoscaling rules = medium, KV caching (multi-tenant correctness) = high, quant recommendation UI + bench tooling = low-medium.
olivia: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Batching: reduces avg cost/token by >=15% on batchable workloads without increasing p99 > 10% over baseline.
- KV caching: correct for prefix reuse; cache invalidation documented; observability for hit-rate >= configurable metric.
- Quant recs: provide model/quant pairings with measured delta in eval set (per-customer prompt set) and a rollback plan.
emily: Edge cases to call out in RFC: very short prompts (1-8 tokens), multi-turn chat with mixed quant models, and memory blowups when KV caches are warm across tenants. Also privacy: ensure no cross-customer KV leakage.
morgan: Good call. Can someone sketch launch criteria (GA) bullets? I want an internal beta first.
raj: GA checklist suggestion:
- Core features implemented (batching + caching + quant recs)
- 2 enterprise customers on beta with acceptance tests passing
- Performance regression tests showing p99 within SLOs in 95% of load patterns
- Docs + SDK snippets + rollback playbook
- Cost impact report + default config set
ess: I'm okay to own beta onboarding and customer acceptance tests.
kevin: I can own infra changes and perf harnesses. I'll add automated chaos tests for cache invalidation.
olivia: I'll produce the quant evaluation template and a checklist for acceptable quality delta (suggest <2% BLEU-like metric or equivalent eval per customer).
emily: One more edge case: quant recommendations must include fallback to full-precision model when eval shows hallucination spike on safety-sensitive prompts. Add as acceptance criteria.
morgan: Nice. Next steps: I'll push RFC draft to docs and tag reviewers. Please add short bullets to the doc by EOD Wed.
rfc-bot: New RFC draft created: https://internal/docs/rfc-optimize-toolkit-draft.md (morgan authored).
kevin: quick question — do we want separate rollout policies per customer tier (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? That affects cache scope and quant enforcement.
raj: Yes — include routing policy matrix: hosted -> conservative quant recs by default, dedicated -> configurable, private -> customer-managed.
morgan: Cool. I'll add that to the spec. If no objections, we'll lock scope for the RFC (MVP) as: batching core + basic KV caching + quant recommendation engine + eval templates and beta onboarding plan. Anything missing?
tess: Add monitoring dashboards and signal-based alerts (hit-rate, avg batch size, p95/p99 latency regression).
emily: Also add a short section on customer-driven scenarios (Acme, BankSys) with acceptance tests.
morgan: Perfect. Thanks all — tagging @kevin @raj @tess for quick PR review once I push. :thumbsup:
